headline: Weathered Expanse Erupts Into Fierce Turmoil as Central Fronts Shift
war_summary: The past three hours brought a sharp escalation across Weathered Expanse, where fierce contested actions logged fourteen base transitions in two hours alone around Spirit Watch and Frostmarch, backed by over eleven hundred combined casualties. Marban Hollow maintains its brutal deadlock, recording eight more flag exchanges in two hours as Checkpoint Bua and Oster Wall continue to change hands. Further west, Linn of Mercy abruptly erupted back into action with five rapid base exchanges centered on Outwich Ranch, while Kuura Strand logged five additional transitions as Colonial drives pressured Faden Point and Menneen. In Pari Peak, combat re-accelerated around Pariah and Camp Surista, yielding four swift base swaps in the latest watch. Meanwhile, the earlier flurry in Olavis Wake and The Gutter has subsided into relative pause without a single base turnover over the last two hours, and the heavy attrition across Callahan's Passage, Farranac Coast, and Stonecradle continues unabated without moving frontline boundaries.
